text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, celecoxib is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 441 units with 33.5 days of supply at current usage. Corvale General holds 524.97 units with 27.2 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 80425009602 identifies Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC (FEI 3017450153) as the repackager. FDA inspection 1249914 of that facility ended on 2024-09-06 and received a Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification. The classification was made known to FDA on 2024-11-13 per an FMD-145 letter.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately one month at both sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. The prior inspection finding at the repackager does not currently restrict distribution. Supply continuity depends on securing additional purchase commitments.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with A-S Medication Solutions, Actavis Pharma Inc., Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee LLC, AiPing Pharmaceutical Inc., and Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. to diversify sourcing; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to confirm manufacturing site information for each alternative supplier before committing volume; requires Quality Assurance approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report any status change to the committee; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
